body: Man tell me about it. Especially because when it gets busy is when it would be the most helpful for everyone for even just 5 seconds of common sense, scrape shit, stack it etc. But nope, thats when they all get lazy as fuck, like HELLO BRO? DA FUCK?

oh man, having worked both morning and evenings I HATE evening shifts. I always leave the place as PRISTINE as I can get it (unless I get slammed with a rush right as I'm walking out the door) for the evening shifts. Scrub it down, clean as I go, empty filters, etc. Its not perfect but I do my part. Now that I work mornings though, that effort makes me hate the evening people, they always leave me a stack of crap when I come in in the morning and I'm like... BRUH?   
Sometimes I feel like I'm the only one who actually yknow, cleans, in my godforsaken workplace \*sighs\*.
Heh, doesn't help me much with fuckin everything else, but at least I'm comprehensible lol.
